# Environment resources

The environment geometry, road markings and safety barriers are authored for this project.

The following project-local texture copies originate from Poly Haven and are CC0:
- env-asphalt.jpg: https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
- env-concrete.jpg: low-contrast neutral aggregate derivative of https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
- env-city-light.jpg: converted from the existing daylight_environment.hdr, https://polyhaven.com/a/urban_street_01

License: https://polyhaven.com/license . These ready-to-use derivatives are included in this repository. Concrete and Asphalt 02 are by Rob Tuytel; Urban Street 01 is by Andreas Mischok. See also `../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.
